title: Other people's opinions
src: Schopenhauer, The Wisdom of Life, ch. 4
idea: Schopenhauer saw concern for what others think as a major source of needless worry and vanity. Their opinion is not your life.
apply: Before you drop something because of what people might say, ask whether that opinion is real or imagined. Then do it anyway.
remind: Care less about imagined opinions. Make the thing.
who: Raj, who paints but never shares his work.

scenes.cap: Raj, every time he considers posting
scenes.nar: Raj has painted for years, but he never shares his work. He keeps wondering what everyone would think.

scenes.cap: What he imagines people will say
scenes.nar: He imagines they will say it looks amateur, or that he is showing off, or that nobody cares. He has no evidence for any of it.

items: Most people are busy with their own lives
A few will care, and say so

scenes.nar: Schopenhauer saw much of our worry as concern for other people's opinions. In reality, most people are busy with their own lives, and a few will genuinely care.
Raj posts one painting a week. Kind messages arrive, then a commission request. The harsh audience was imaginary.
